700311.full: ἀεί, adv., [in LXX: Isa.42:14 (מֵעוֹלָם) 51:13 (תָּמִיד), Ps 94(95):10, al. ;] ever; __1. of continuous time, unceasingly, perpetually: Act.7:51, 2 Co.4.11; 6:10, Tit.1:12, Heb.3:10. __2. Of successive occurrences, on every occasion (MM, VGT, see word): 1Pe.3:15, 2Pe.1:12. † (AS)

700316.full: not-working, idle , (Homer), etc.;—; ἀεργοὶ δόμοι idle houses, i. e. where people are idle , (Theocritus Poeta Bucolicus)—;Cf. attic ἀργός. (ML)

700318.full: ἀετός, -οῦ, ὁ, [in LXX for נֶשֶׁר ;] an eagle: Rev.4:7 8:13 (Rec. ἀγγέλου) 12:14. Where carrion is referred to, ἀ. is probably a vulture (cf. Job.39:30, Pro.30:17): Mat.24:28, Luk.17:37 (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

700345.lxx: in LXX for מָצָּה; τὰ ἄ. (sc. λάγανα, cakes) = הַמָצָּה
700345.full: ἄζυμος, -ον (ζύμη), [in LXX for מָצָּה; τὰ ἄ. (sc. λάγανα, cakes) = הַמָצָּה ;] unleavened: ἡ ἑορτὴ τῶν ἄ. (הַג הַמָצָּה), the paschal feast (also called τὰ ἄ., Mrk.14:1), Luk.22:1; ἡμέρα τῶν ἄ., Mat.26:17, Mrk.14:12, Luk.22:7; ἡμέραι, Act.12:3 20:6. Fig., of Christians, free from corruption: 1Co.5:7; exhorted to keep festival, ἐν ἀζύμοις (sc. ἄρτοις, λάγανοις, or, indefinitely, "unleavened elements"), ib. 8 (Cremer, 724).† (AS)

700352.full: ἀηδία, -ας, ἡ (ἀ- neg., ἦδος, pleasure), [in LXX: Pr 2329 (שִׂיחַ)* ;] __1. of things or persons, unpleasantness, odiousness (Hipp., Dem., al.); __2. dislike (Plat.), disagreement (MM, VGT, see word): Luk.23:12 D. † (AS)

700354.full: ἀήρ, ἀέρος, ὁ, [in LXX: 2Ki.22:12 (= Psa.17(18):11 שׁחק), Wi .8 ;] in Hom., Hes., the lower air which surrounds the earth, as opposite to the purer αἰθήρ of the higher regions; generally, air (MM, VGT, see word): Act.22:23, 1Th.4:17, Rev.9:2 16:17; of the air as the realm of demons, Eph.2:2; ἀ. δέρειν, of striving to no purpose, 1Co.9:26; εἰς ἀ. λαλεῖν, of speaking without effect, not being understood, 1Co.14:9.† (AS)

700357.full: ἀθανασία, -ας, ἡ (ἀ-θάνατος, undying; V. MM, VGT, see word), [in LXX: Wis.3:4 4:1 8:13,17 15:3, 4Ma.14:5 16:13 * ;] immortality: 1Co.15:53,54 1Ti.6:16 (cf. Cremer, 285 f.).† (AS)

700360.full: Athanim or Ethanim, or Tishri; the first month of the civil calendar and seventh month of the religious calendar

700363.full: ἀ-θέμιτος (late form of ἀθέμιστος, LS, MM, VGT, see word), -ον (θέμις, custom, right), [in LXX: 2Ma.6:5 7:1 10:34, 3Ma.5:20 * ;] __(a) of persons, lawless (III Mac, l.with); __(b) of things, lawless, unlawful: Act.10:28, 1Pe.4:3.† SYN.: see: ἄθεσμος. (AS)

700367.full: ἄθεσμος, -ον (θεσμός, law, custom), [in LXX: 3Ma.5:12 6:26 * ;] lawless, esp. of those who violate the law of nature and conscience (cf. MM, VGT, see word): 2Pe.2:7 3:17.† SYN.: ἀθέμιτος, ἄνομος, κακός, πονηρός, φαῦλος (see Tr., Syn., §lxxiv; DCG, ii, 821b). (AS)

s: do away with what has been laid down
700369.lxx: in LXX for seventeen different words, פּשׁע, מרד, בּגד, מעל, etc., often meaning, as 1Ki.13:3 (Heb., al.), to revolt; properly, to make ἄθετον , or do away with what has been laid down (see DCG, i, 453 f.)
700369.full: ἀθετέω, -ῶ (τίθημι), [in LXX for seventeen different words, פּשׁע, מרד, בּגד, מעל, etc., often meaning, as 1Ki.13:3 (Heb., al.), to revolt; properly, to make ἄθετον , or do away with what has been laid down (see DCG, i, 453 f.)]. __1. to set aside, disregard (in Gramm., to reject as spurious): διαθήκην , Gal.3:16; ἐντολήν , Mrk.7:9; νόμον . Heb.10:28; πίστιν , 1Ti.5:12. __2. to nullify, make void: Luk.7:30 (see Field, Notes, 59), 1Co.1:19, Gal.2:21. __3. to reject: Mrk.6:26 (Field, op. cit., 30), Lk 10:16, Jhn.12:48, I Th 48, Ju 8 (for exx. in π., see MM, VGT, see word). † (AS)

700371.lxx: in LXX, usually of unfaithful, rebellious action: 1Ki.24:12 (פֶּשַׁע), Jer.12:1 (בֶּגֶד),  Da TH 9:7 (מַעַל), 2Ma.14:28 *
700371.full: ἀθέτησις, -εως, ἡ (ἀθετέω), [in LXX, usually of unfaithful, rebellious action: 1Ki.24:12 (פֶּשַׁע), Jer.12:1 (בֶּגֶד), Da TH 9:7 (מַעַל), 2Ma.14:28 * ;] a disannulling, setting aside: Heb.7:18 9:26 (for similar usage in π., see Deiss., BS, 228 f.; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

700373.full: Athenian, of or from Athens , (Iliad by Homer), etc (ML)

700375.full: Αθιν Jathin - a name found only in LXX at 1Ch.8.25 with no equivalent in the Hebrew text

700384.full: ἀθροίζω (ἀθρόος, assembled in crowds, MM, VGT, see word; θρόος, a noise, tumult), [in LXX chiefly for קבץ ;] to gather, assemble: Luk.24:33.† (AS)

700387.full: ἀθυμέω, -ῶ (ἄ-θυμος, without heart), [in LXX for חרה, etc. ;] to be disheartened: Col.3:21.† (AS)

700388.full: want of heart, faintheartedness , (Herdotus Historicus), etc.; εἰς ἀθυμίαν καθιστάναι τινά (Plato Philosophus); ἀθυμίαν παρέχειν τινί (Xenophon Historicus); ἐν ἀθυμίαι εἶναι (Xenophon Historicus); ἀθυμία ἐμπίπτει τινί (Xenophon Historicus) (ML)

700389.full: 1. not offered , i. e. neglected , ἱερὰ ἄθ., Lat. sacra inauspicata, (Aeschines Orator) 2. active without sacrificing , ἄθυτος ἀπελθεῖν (Xenophon Historicus) (ML)

700390.lxx: in LXX chiefly for נקה ni., pi., נָקִי
700390.full: ἀθῷος (Rec. wrongly, -ῶος; LS, see word; Mayser, 131), -ον (θωή, a penalty), [in LXX chiefly for נקה ni., pi., נָקִי ;] __1. unpunished (MM, VGT, see word). __2. innocent: Mat.27:4 (WH, R, mg., δίκαιον) 27:24. (AS)

700395.full: αἴγειος (WH, -γιος), -α, -ον (αἶξ, a goat), [in LXX for עֵז ;] of a goat: Heb.11:37 (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

700396.full: αἰγιαλός, -οῦ, ὁ (on the derivation, see Boisacq, see word), [in LXX: Jdg.5:17 (חוֹף), Sir.24:14 * ;] the sea-shore, beach (cf. Field, Notes, 146; DCG, i, 175 f.; MM, VGT, see word): Mat.13:2,48 Jhn.21:4, Act.21:5 27:39,40.† (AS)
